weatherPainter.name: Weather painter
weatherPainter.description: Paints the place in its weather and light right now.

sources.config.json:
{
  "name": "Weather painter",
  "category": "data",
  "description": "Paints the place in its weather and light right now.",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "fields": [
    {
      "name": "location",
      "label": "Location",
      "type": "string",
      "value": "Brussels"
    },
    {
      "name": "every",
      "label": "Paint a new one every",
      "type": "select",
      "value": "6",
      "options": [
        "3",
        "6",
        "12",
        "24"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "style",
      "label": "Painted as",
      "type": "select",
      "value": "surprise",
      "options": [
        "surprise",
        "woodblock",
        "impressionist",
        "poster",
        "watercolor",
        "dutch",
        "linocut",
        "gouache",
        "realist",
        "pixel",
        "nouveau"
      ]
    },
    {
      "name": "imageModel",
      "label": "Image model",
      "type": "select",
      "value": "gpt-image-2",
      "options": [
        "gpt-image-2",
        "gpt-image-1.5",
        "gpt-image-1"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "output": [
    {
      "name": "image",
      "type": "image"
    }
  ],
  "permissions": [
    "assets",
    "assets-write"
  ],
  "settings": [
    "openAI"
  ]
}

weatherCard.name: Weather card
weatherCard.description: The card over the painted weather.
